reason: Project lens: not refuted. Not protected, not generated (src/render.6502 is hand-written), not raster-timed, no new RAM: it writes ra_lo (&59, ren_zp, renderer-only) as before and stops writing ra_hi (&6B), which only raise_address names (grep src/ tools/). Runs in bank 4 at &9D49 (above ANDY's &8000-&8FFF), so ROMSEL &84/&04 and ACCCON's X bit change nothing: the self-modified operands lo_imm/rows_imm are still written by the same STA/STY by label and read in the same bank. No entry past a label (only JSR raise_address at render.6502:1606). The ring fix ORA #&40 equals CMP #&40/BCS/ADC #&40 for any result in &00-&7F; hi is dm_scr_hi = movers_screen_address_high, only ever written by the original's ring arithmetic (add/subtract_delta, subtract_Y_rows, use_player_position) and shield.6502's rewind via subtract_delta, all &40-&7F, and the old code already assumed that (its CMP #&40 handles no hi >= &80); minus at most &15 there is no borrow. Only exit difference: C on the up path when it wraps (old 0, new 1); every consumer sets C before reading it (compiled_part ASL, draw_column.each SEC/CLC, kc_part via kc_find's CMPs, the flipped path CLC; sky.6502's caller goes through ren_draw_sprite too). Size: 66 -> 57 bytes (recounted), raise_cells_lo/hi slide to &9D82-&9D91 with Y 0-7 in page &9D; BCS forward 39 bytes in range and same page. Bank 4 render region only shrinks. Cycles recounted: up path 74 -> 62 (75 -> 62 when it wraps), stay path 14 -> 15; the claim's 12.2 per execution is the up path's saving, net about 23-29 a pass at 2.55/1.65 calls.
